items.title: Darboe warns Gambia will ‘sink’ if President Barrow is re-elected
items.summary: By Dawda Baldeh Opposition United Democratic Party leader Ousainou Darboe has warned that re-electing President Adama Barrow in December would be disastrous for The Gambia, claiming the situation could become so dire he might consider taking the irregular migration route to Eu...
